test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: On a certain sum, simple interest for 2 years is Rs. 9,600 whereas the compound interest compounded annually is Rs. 10,176. What is the rate of interest per annum?
solution:
Formula:

P = SI×100over R× T

A = P × (1 + Rover 100)T

CI = A - P

where-

A = Amount from Compound Interest

P = Principal

SI = Simple Interest

R = Rate

T = Time

CI = Compound Interest

**Concept:**

Compound interest includes interest calculated on the interest portion for the subsequent period. Hence, the compound interest for the 2nd year is the interest calculated on the interest for the 1st year along with the interest for the 2nd year. 

⇒ Difference between CI and SI for 2 years = Interest calculated on the interest part for the 1st year.

**Calculation:**

SI for one year = 9600 ÷ 2 = Rs 4800

Difference between CI and SI for 2 years = Rs 10,176 - Rs 9600 = Rs 576

Rate of Interest = 576over 4800 × 100 = 12%

**∴ Rate of interest is 12 p.a.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

CI and SI for the 1st year are the same. Compound Interest comes into play from the second year provided interest is calculated annually.
